## Automated Tests Required

### 1-1 Input Action Asset & Context Controller — Integration

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/input/Story001ContextControllerTests.cs` (asmdef `InputIntegrationTests`)
**What to test**:
- Exactly-one-action-map invariant across all MVP contexts (AC-45, ADR-0005)
- Submit/Cancel routing via named counters — `SubmitCount`/`CancelCount`/`GameplayEdgeCount`/`PauseEdgeCount` (AC-12/13/35/49)
- `InputSettings.UpdateMode == ProcessEventsInDynamicUpdate` (AC-30, ADR-0005 — enum renamed in 1.19.0)
- Navigate boundary non-wrap via `FocusPositionObserver` (AC-47)
- Asset shape: exactly 11 Core-Rule-1 actions, zero template actions present or enabled (AC-69, ADR-0005)
- Sole-ownership: no external activation API; global sweep by `ReferenceEquals` (ADR-0005)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Transition frames, held controls across transitions
- Asset identity by `ReferenceEquals` (all wrappers share the same JSON — identity by name is a false match)
- Template-action exclusion (Jump/Move/Look/Fire/Sprint)

**Estimated test count**: ~8

---

### 1-2 Raw Capture & Dead-Zone Normalization — Integration

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/input/Story002RawCaptureDeadZoneTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Radial dead-zone: magnitudes 0 / 0.15 → 0.0; 0.55 → 0.5; 0.95 / 1.0 → 1.0, direction preserved (AC-4/25/32)
- Axial trigger: 0.0 / 0.05 → 0.0; 0.525 → 0.5; 1.0 (AC-24/33)
- Keyboard/mouse bypass dead-zone unchanged (AC-51)
- Capture exactly-once per Update + monotonic `captureSequence` + before-accumulator order (AC-59, ADR-0001)
- Stick raw via `ReadUnprocessedValue()` (bypasses embedded `axisDeadzone`), resolved through controls scan, not `activeControl`

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Boundary inclusivity (0.15 / 0.95 / 0.05)
- Diagonal input, out-of-range values, zero ticks, repeated render Updates

**Estimated test count**: ~7

---

### 1-3 EMA & Brake Priority — Logic

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/input/Story003EmaBrakePriorityTests.cs` (asmdef `InputUnitTests`)
**What to test**:
- EMA recurrence exact values (α=0.3, raw=1.0: 0.3, 0.51, 0.657, 0.7599, 0.83193; ≥0.95 on tick 9) (AC-1/2/3/6)
- Alpha endpoints: α=0.0 retains previous; α=1.0 equals raw exactly (AC-27)
- Brake priority: Accelerate output forced to 0.0 while raw brake > 0; brake follows its EMA (AC-5/38)
- Freeze/resume: Accelerate EMA frozen at pre-brake value; resumes from it, never 0 nor accumulated-during-braking (AC-42)
- No suppression when brake post-dead-zone == 0 (AC-31)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Alpha endpoints 0.0/1.0, negative steer values
- Brake exactly at / just above threshold
- Multiple brake ticks, partial throttle changes

**Estimated test count**: ~9

---

### 1-4 SimulationInput Tick Processor — Integration

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/input/Story004TickProcessorTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Render-rate independence: bitwise-identical `SimulationInput` at 30 FPS and 144 FPS for identical raw sequences across 60 ticks (AC-7, ADR-0001)
- Raw NaN/Infinity → last valid output retained + `InvalidInputWarning` (channel id + value), 1 per channel per 60-tick window, identical for NaN and ±Infinity (AC-22)
- Pause edge consumed exactly once: tick1 true, tick2+ false (AC-28)
- Multi-tick reuse: two ticks from one sample produce 0.3 then 0.51; Pause consumed only on first tick (AC-34)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Multi-tick / zero-tick render frames, pending-pause fixture
- NaN / positive / negative Infinity, rate-limit window boundary

**Estimated test count**: ~4 + determinism harness

---

### 1-5 Scheme Arbitration & No-Device — Logic

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/unit/input/Story005SchemeArbitrationTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Last-meaningful-device wins; KeyboardMouse startup default (AC-43)
- Same-frame both-schemes meaningful events → no oscillation (AC-62)
- NoInputDevice → zeroed values + `inputAvailability == NoInputDevice`, recovers on valid scheme (AC-9)
- Scheme switch: EMA previous values initialized from new post-dead-zone sample (AC-23/39), pending Pause cleared (AC-40)
- Meaningful events resolve before raw capture in the same Dynamic Update (AC-60)
- Prompt-glyph consumer receives the resolved scheme (AC-61)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Threshold boundaries (trigger 0.05, stick inner 0.15, pointer delta 2 px)
- Disconnect during qualifying, held analog input, simultaneous events

**Estimated test count**: ~9

---

### 1-6 Context Handoff & Transitions — Integration

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/input/Story006ContextTransitionsTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Handoff latching: digital actions + UI Navigate latched until neutral/release; pending `pauseEdge` cleared; EMA previous values initialized from current post-dead-zone (AC-41/53/44)
- Countdown: grid lock holds car, driving input processed, no pit entry (AC-14/16)
- Countdown Pause → UI → resume returns to frozen countdown tick; Settings blocked until Pause (AC-15/17)
- EMA continuity Countdown → Racing without reset (AC-18)
- Qualifying pause resumes into GameplayQualifying (AC-37)
- Loading transitions gated by `RaceLoadReady(RaceMode.Race/Qualifying)` (AC-56/70)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Held controls across transitions (Pause, Confirm, Cancel, Navigate, CameraToggle)
- EventSystem settle frame: wait one frame after UI-context activation before simulating presses (Input System gotcha #1835)
- Transitions driven by explicit lifecycle events (mocked Simulation/Settings/Content/RSM/Pit Stop), not real scenes

**Estimated test count**: ~11

---

### 1-7 Special Input Routing — Integration

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/input/Story007SpecialRoutingTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- CameraToggle: exactly one same-frame `Camera.ToggleRequest` per press, none while held, never in SimulationInput/Ghost Recording (AC-58, ADR-0010)
- Mouse UI-only: mouse never produces Accelerate/Brake/Steer (AC-26)
- Pointer visibility + UI scheme arbitration (pointer delta ≥ 2 px / Click vs keyboard/gamepad) (AC-36/48)
- PitService: Confirm gated by tire-swap completion, routes directly to Pit Stop exactly once with current fuel; no generic UI Submit (AC-52/64)
- Finished Presentation: Confirm → QualifyingResults; P toggles terminal timer only; Cancel suppressed (AC-54/57/63)
- Blocked modes (PitTransit, Loading) emit no events (AC-65)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Held buttons, repeated presses, transition-frame input, pointer delta 2 px / 1.99 px boundary

**Estimated test count**: ~10

---

### 1-8 Settings Configuration — Integration

**Test file path**: `Assets/tests/integration/input/Story008SettingsConfigurationTests.cs`
**What to test**:
- Listening classification: Captured (valid non-conflicting) / Conflict (conflicts with non-reserved binding) / Rejected (reserved, malformed, exceeded) — AC-10/29, ADR-0005
- Preview uses working profile; first resumed tick uses same profile (AC-11)
- Reserved Confirm/Cancel/Pause bindings cannot be selected or removed (AC-46)
- Per-slot override only (Steer Left Secondary); unknown-ID fallback preserves valid overrides (AC-66/67)
- Profile field validation: `0 ≤ stick_inner < stick_outer ≤ 1`, `0 ≤ trigger_inner < 1`, alpha ∈ [0,1]; per-field fallback + per-field named warning, 1 per load (AC-68, ADR-0004)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Reserved / malformed / exceeded candidates
- NaN / ±Infinity thresholds, unknown binding IDs, trigger threshold NOT player-owned

**Estimated test count**: ~8

## Manual QA Checklist

No Visual/Feel or UI stories in this sprint — all 8 are Logic/Integration, verified by automated tests. The only manual verification required is the smoke check below.

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for this sprint:

1. Editor/player compiles without errors; Play Mode starts with 0 asserts
2. `OverdriveGameplay`/`OverdriveUI` actions generated and enabled; exactly-one-map invariant holds across context transitions
3. Input → `SimulationInput` per tick at 60 Hz (capture 1x/frame, correct EMA/dead-zone values)
4. Dead-zone/EMA/brake respond correctly with both gamepad and keyboard
5. No new frame spikes — capture is O(1), zero allocations per tick
6. Settings (story 8) control-profile changes persist/restore without corruption

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check sprint`. Reference this list when running that skill.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories (unit: 1-3, 1-5; integration: 1-1, 1-2, 1-4, 1-6, 1-7, 1-8)
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for all Visual/Feel and UI stories (none in this sprint)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
